implementation_url: analysis/causalarena_methods.py --method gesbic (cc-research repository, UCSD DSC 180 capstone; not public)
contact: to be filled in before any submission
training_disclosure: N/A: classical method, no training or pretraining; no CausalArena SCMs, samples, metadata or generators used for tuning (all settings are the published defaults fixed before the runs)

evaluation.hardware: cloud VM, 2 CPU cores, 7 GB RAM, no GPU
evaluation.notes: rows from causalarena_methods.py --method gesbic --family <family> [--file-list plans/synth_sample_100.txt] --file-timeout-s <t> --shuffle-seed 20261010; per-family timeouts in row_sources

config: ges 1.1.0 (Gamella) fit_bic on z-scored columns: Gaussian l0-penalised likelihood, lambda = log(n)/2, forward/backward/turning phases (the score of the published GIES row on observational files)
regime: D: observational data only (obs-only files; no interventions, no variable names, no knowledge)

controls.shuffle: per-file permutation default_rng(20261010 + crc32(file name)); the graph is mapped back to the released node order before scoring and before writing predictions
controls.released_order_note: the released column order is topological in the public files (column_order_check.json); a method that reads column order can benefit from it

orientation_rule: undecided pairs (CPDAG undirected, PAG o->, o-o, <->, LiNGAM/NOTEARS 2-cycles) oriented at random with seed crc32(file name) (CausalArena Appendix B.2/B.4); adjacency in predictions/*.npz is that oriented graph
shd_variant: one per unordered pair whose predicted arrows differ from the true arrow(s) (REP-06)
nshd_definition: shd / (d (d - 1) / 2), ours; not taken from CausalArena

failed_rows.note: metrics left blank as the summary schema allows; our family means score them as empty graphs
